To figure out what's worth your time, you may need to engage in more self-reflection and exploration. By taking the time to reflect on these questions and explore your own values and priorities, you can create a personalized framework for deciding what's worth your time and energy. This may involve setting personal goals, prioritizing relationships and activities that bring you joy, and being mindful of how you allocate your time and attention. Ultimately, not having a traditional religious or cultural framework can be a liberating experience, allowing you to create your own path and priorities.
